title: Classify one signed GMGN holdings failure with safe codes only
objective: After the local-only diagnostic confirmed both required GMGN variable names are present, issue exactly one new signed, read-only GMGN portfolio-holdings request for the frozen Owner-supplied Solana wallet below. Validate the wallet as strict Base58 and exactly 32 bytes before construction. Capture child stdout/stderr in process memory only; map a failed response to one allowlisted diagnostic code based on generic credential/signature, rate-limit, network/transport or parse indicators without storing, printing or quoting any provider text. On success, retain only the same first-page bounded counts and allowlisted numeric history-profit aggregates as the prior pilot. This task cannot reuse or retry the prior task invocation and cannot claim complete historical profitability.
forbidden_actions: Do not call a chain other than Solana or a provider other than GMGN.
Do not run more than one GMGN CLI invocation; do not paginate, retry, discover, call Helius or invoke any other GMGN command.

Do not print, persist, commit or quote API keys, private keys, credential-bearing URLs, raw GMGN payloads, arbitrary provider text, full exception text, token mints, token names, transaction signatures, counterparties or per-trade records.

Do not claim complete all-time wallet PnL, a chain-confirmed realized profit, win rate, wallet quality, wallet classification, common ownership, clustering, address-library admission or Alpha N/R/SR/SSR/UR tier.
Do not write a database, cache, queue, address library, scheduler, production system, transaction, signing, swap, order or trade.
Do not write outside the exact tracked write set.
